ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by accuracy needs. This is a deterministic conversion-and-arithmetic problem with a single verifiable answer, and the user explicitly flagged prior errors, so getting it right matters most. Petrel-235B outscores Plover-235B on every reasoning/accuracy benchmark (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2), and neither model's task preferences are relevant to a short, well-specified math task. So Petrel was the higher-capability fit for a query where correctness is the priority.
